fullDescription: A monochrome ink-on-paper footer with a four-column mega grid, mono type, newsletter pill input, and a slim legal row with socials and a language switch.
prompt: {"style": "Strict ink-on-paper monochrome: ink #0a0a0a on paper #ffffff, with grey text tiers smoke #6b6b6b, coal #525252, haze #9a9a9a, hairlines line #e7e7e7, and a faint #f5f5f4 wash on the legal bar; one emerald #10b981 status dot is the only color accent. Fonts via Google Fonts: JetBrains Mono for nearly all UI/body/links and Space Grotesk for the wordmark and headings. Mood is editorial, technical, calm and high-craft. Accent treatment is restraint plus motion: uppercase mono micro-labels at ~10-11px with 0.14em tracking, link underlines that wipe in left-to-right on hover (1px ink), and pill buttons in solid ink with paper text.", "summary": "Build a frameless, full-width monochrome website footer with a brand block, three nav columns, a newsletter pill, and a slim legal bar.", "special_notes": "Frameless: no browser chrome, no device mockup, no drop shadow, just the footer section on a white page. Full-bleed background colors with the inner content capped at 1180px. Edge detail is the heavier ink top border versus the lighter #e7e7e7 hairlines that segment the internal rows, and a faint #f5f5f4 wash that visually anchors the bottom legal bar. Keep all text WCAG-legible against paper (coal/smoke greys, not haze for body). Absolutely no generic indigo/violet/blue SaaS gradient slop, no glassmorphism: this is a precise mono system, ink and paper only with a single emerald dot.", "layout_and_structure": "Frameless full-bleed footer opened by a top border in ink (border-t border-ink), content centered in a max-w-[1180px] container with px-6 / md:px-10 gutters. Top band is a 12-column grid (md:grid-cols-12): brand block spans 4 cols (wordmark with a rounded-7px ink logo tile, a short tagline, and an emerald status dot reading 'All systems operational'), a 1-col spacer, then a 3-up nav cluster spanning 7 cols (Product, Resources, Company) with mono uppercase headers and stacked link lists. A newsletter strip sits below on its own row, divided by a top hairline. Then a slim legal bar in the faint wash, separated by another hairline: left side holds copyright plus a thin vertical divider and inline legal links (Terms, Privacy, Security, Status, Cookies), right side holds the social row and the language switch. Responsive reflow: desktop is the full 12-col layout with the legal bar as a single justified row; tablet keeps nav at 3 columns while the brand stacks; mobile collapses everything to one column (grid-cols-1, nav to 2 cols), the newsletter goes full width, and the legal bar stacks vertically (flex-col) with links wrapping.", "special_ui_components": ["Newsletter input+button as a single rounded-full pill bordered in ink with a leading mail icon, an email field, and an inline ink Subscribe button (arrow-up-right) plus a focus ring; a status pill with an emerald dot; a five-icon social row (X, GitHub, YouTube, Discord, LinkedIn) as bordered round buttons that lift and invert to solid ink on hover; a language switch button (globe + 'English' + chevron-down); a separate sample hero section above with a '2,140 prompts' count pill and a 'Browse the library' CTA shown only for context."]}
